text: athena land --pr refuses every pull request since 29fdd4c: pr_commits in crates/athena-core/src/land.rs requires exactly one Athena-Job trailer on every commit between the remote base and the PR head, but a pull request also carries commits that change no governed content (records only, or owner paths such as operator/ and BRIEF.md) and declared interventions, which carry none; job 20261024-114125-7z2t's landing failed on a lease commit (f499abc). Sri asked that attribution not depend on commit-message trailers. Classify each commit by its content instead: a commit that leaves governed content unchanged (the gate's fingerprint, as athena-gate's invariant does) is listed as records-only; a commit that adds an intervention record is listed as that declared intervention; a commit that adds a job's closing records (candidate, verification, landed outcome) is that job's landing; any other commit that changes governed content is refused, naming it. Extend the Landing record's per-commit entry to carry that kind (job landing, declared intervention, records-only), keeping validation strict. Test against a range shaped like this repository's real pull requests: reading, dispatch and introspection commits, a lease commit, an intervention, then the job's landing.
